name: grillmycode
description: The companion to the GrillMyCode GitHub Action. Shows the questions it wrote about your code, beside the code they ask about.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: GrillMyCode finds your questions through VS Code's Git support, which is switched off in Restricted Mode. Trust the folder to see them.

grillmycode.workflowHelp.enabled.markdownDescription: Check the GrillMyCode step of a workflow file as you type, and offer its inputs and their values. Applies to files in `.github/workflows`.

viewsWelcome.contents: Open a folder that is a clone of a GitHub repository to see its GrillMyCode questions.

This folder is open in Restricted Mode, which switches off the Git support GrillMyCode needs. Trust the folder to see your questions.
[Manage Workspace Trust](command:workbench.trust.manage)

Sign in to GitHub to load the questions for this repository.
[Sign in to GitHub](command:grillmycode.signIn)

GitHub could not find this repository for the account that is signed in. Check that you are signed in with the account that owns the assignment.
[Try Again](command:grillmycode.refresh)

No GrillMyCode questions were found for this repository. They appear after you push and the GrillMyCode workflow finishes.
[Refresh](command:grillmycode.refresh)

These questions were written by a newer version of GrillMyCode than this extension can read. Update GrillMyCode Companion to see them here. Until then, they are in the issue on GitHub.
[Show GrillMyCode Companion](command:extension.open?%5B%22GrillMyCode.grillmycode%22%5D)
[Refresh](command:grillmycode.refresh)

The questions could not be loaded. The GrillMyCode output channel has the details.
[Try Again](command:grillmycode.refresh)

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with GrillMyCode Companion
walkthroughs.description: Your GrillMyCode questions, beside the code they ask about.

steps.title: Open your assignment's folder
steps.description:
Open the folder you cloned from GitHub for this assignment. GrillMyCode Companion finds your questions from it.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)
completionEvents: onContext:grillmycode.state == signedOut || grillmycode.state == noAccess || grillmycode.state == noIssue || grillmycode.state == needsUpdate || grillmycode.state == error || grillmycode.state == ready

steps.title: Sign in to GitHub
steps.description:
With the folder open, sign in so GrillMyCode Companion can read the questions in your repository.
[Sign in to GitHub](command:grillmycode.signIn)
completionEvents: onContext:grillmycode.state == noIssue || grillmycode.state == needsUpdate || grillmycode.state == ready

steps.title: Get your questions
steps.description:
GrillMyCode writes your questions when it runs on your repository, which is usually when you push or tag your work. They take a few minutes to arrive, and this step is ticked once they are showing.
[Show the GrillMyCode View](command:grillmycode.questions.focus)
Waited a few minutes? [Refresh Questions](command:grillmycode.refresh)

steps.title: Go from a question to its code
steps.description:
Select a question in the list to open its file, with the lines it asks about highlighted. The whole question is shown under the list.
[Show the GrillMyCode View](command:grillmycode.questions.focus)

media.altText: The Questions list, grouped by file, with question 1 selected. Beside it, the editor shows cart.js with lines 1 to 9 highlighted.
